verdict.rationale: The only first-party web-capture flow in the evidence is Bookmarks: given a URL, Anytype creates a Bookmark Object and stores the page's title, description, preview image and favicon as Properties. That covers capturing a web page reference into the knowledge base, but only as metadata. There is no evidence of a browser extension or clipper, full article-content capture, or highlight capture. Missing for 10: official browser clipper/extension, full article text capture, highlight/selection clipping, one-click capture from the browser, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
